---
title: "Phase 3 syntax-highlighting check"
format: html
---

This document exercises browser-side syntax highlighting in the hub-client.
After opening it in a hub-client preview, the code blocks below should render
with `hl-keyword`, `hl-string`, `hl-function-builtin`, and similar `hl-*`
span classes visible in the DOM.

## Python

```python
def greet(name):
    print(f"hi, {name}")
```

## R

```r
x <- c(1, 2, 3)
mean(x)
```

## JavaScript

```javascript
const add = (a, b) => a + b;
```

## Bash

```bash
greet() {
  echo "hello, $1"
}
```

## JSON

```json
{"n": 1, "s": "x"}
```

## YAML

```yaml
title: "hello"
count: 1
```

## CSS

```css
p.intro { color: red; font-weight: bold; }
```

## Inline code

The Python function `print()`{.python} is a builtin.
